_comment: Pterodactyl/Pelican egg for NTNH-Server — Nuclear Tech: New Horizons
name: NTNH-Server
author: NTNH Team
description:
Nuclear Tech: New Horizons modpack server for Minecraft 1.7.10.

Requires Java 8 and at least 4 GB RAM.

On first install the egg clones the repo and pulls Git LFS objects.
The server JAR and all mod files are tracked via Git LFS.

installation.script:
#! /bin/bash
# NTNH-Server installation script
# Dependencies: git, git-lfs, curl, unzip

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git git-lfs curl unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Clone the repo (shallow clone for speed)
git init
git remote add origin https://github.com/NTNewHorizons/NTNH-Server.git
git fetch --depth 1 origin main
git checkout main

# Pull LFS objects
git lfs install
git lfs pull

# Verify critical files exist
if [ ! -f server.jar ]; then
    echo "ERROR: server.jar not found after LFS pull. Trying fallback..."
    curl -sL -o server.jar https://github.com/NTNewHorizons/NTNH-Server/raw/main/server.jar
fi

if [ ! -f forge-1.7.10-10.13.4.1614-1.7.10-universal.jar ]; then
    curl -sL -o forge-1.7.10-10.13.4.1614-1.7.10-universal.jar https://github.com/NTNewHorizons/NTNH-Server/raw/main/forge-1.7.10-10.13.4.1614-1.7.10-universal.jar
fi

# Ensure line endings are Unix
dos2unix start.sh 2>/dev/null || sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh
chmod +x start.sh

echo "Installation complete. Server will start on boot."

variables.description: Message of the Day shown in the server list.
